verdict.rationale: Okta documents event hooks, which send outbound HTTPS calls to a URL you specify when specified events occur. It also documents SCIM-based user provisioning for pushing user and group CRUD operations to apps. Together these provide event triggers and app-by-app provisioning, but you must build and host the receiving service yourself, so this is code-centric rather than no-code. Missing for 10: any evidence of a no-code workflow builder, specific hire/role-change/departure lifecycle templates, an orchestrated deprovisioning flow, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
